title: DataNexus
tagline: Building Trust around storage & Building Trust around storage
description: Data Nexus is all about easy a platform that allows easy deal creation for the users with good UI and UX and safe storage on Spheron, along with the integration of LIT protocol for encryption logic with PKP integration for easy user onboarding notifying the client for their deal acceptance and approval is very important so we have push notification for that as well.
how_its_made:
Integration with LIT Protocol:
Incorporated the Lit Protocol into your app to facilitate the encryption and decryption process.

Spheron : Storage Wizard
Firstly with the help of LIT protocol we have added the encryption module on the Spheron SDK, that will allow developers to encrypt the files via a wallet public key or by a user-generated password. The whole app is now about allowing the users to easily upload the file via Spheron storage SDK to IPFS and then create the deal on FVM.

FVM
Good news !! Now we have a UI for deal creation on FVM, which involves the process of data preparation till deal creation. We have made use of Client Contract for deal creation.

PUSH
You don't need to wait for when the SP would accept your deal or if your deal proposal was created successfully or not. Using Push we notify the users regarding both the events.

IPFS
Contributed to the https://github.com/ipfs-examples/helia-examples here https://github.com/rk-rishikesh/helia-fvm-deal-prep - Using this the developers and quickly create the frontend required for producing the necessary data for deal creation on FVM
